Title: Foundation arithmetic method
Content: Preserve explicit operation structure, compute grouped operations before outer operations, then submit a concise candidate for independent verification.

Title: Foundation logic method
Content: Translate each statement into explicit constraints, test consistent assignments, and submit a candidate for independent verification.

Title: Foundation structure method
Content: Preserve the requested schema and transform only the specified fields, then validate the complete structure independently.

Title: Foundation debugging method
Content: Reproduce the failure, isolate the smallest causal change, and validate the proposed fix with an independent check.

Title: Foundation recovery method
Content: Treat the first attractive route as provisional, generate an independent alternative, and verify the final candidate before acceptance.
